scope: Owner-authorized repair of the remaining Windows Python-runner environment assertion, without weakening secret isolation. Focused verification only; no target operations.

rootCause.summary: libuv adds its required Windows variables to an explicit child environment when omitted. Ten non-allowlisted parent values reached Python. The failed exact-key assertion revealed this behavior.

changes: On Windows, explicitly pass SYSTEMROOT as the required socket capability; if missing, pass an empty value rather than allowing implicit refill.
Explicitly blank HOMEDRIVE, HOMEPATH, LOGONSERVER, SYSTEMDRIVE, TEMP, USERDOMAIN, USERNAME, USERPROFILE and WINDIR so parent values are not inherited by default.

Normalize safe explicit extra names to uppercase on Windows and reject case-insensitive duplicates. Existing forbidden-name validation remains unchanged; safe explicit extras retain documented precedence.

Preserve exact-key, secret, seed, request/response/time limit, abort, safe-import and stderr assertions; add static nine-key empty-value checks, mixed-case parent canaries, duplicate handling and native socket/tempfile/import checks.
rejectedApproach: Blanking all ten defaults prevented parent-value inheritance but failed actual socket creation with Windows error 10106. That approach was not committed. Keeping SYSTEMROOT explicitly passes the compatibility checks.
